purpose: Mechanistic training-only diagnosis, not candidate selection or independent generalization
inputs: Existing TRAIN cached features and boxes
Existing TRAIN labels/scopes and separately reviewed TRAIN absence overlays
assignment_probe: Replay frozen baseline outputs and compare actual Hungarian match to class-agnostic one-to-one TRAIN box coverage; measure score and scope bottlenecks

capacity_probe.group: release identity_group; deterministic stratified greedy grouping, no identity overlap between folds
capacity_probe.positive_policy: 17 unambiguous positive TRAIN photos; exclude prior three category-boundary holds
capacity_probe.negative_policy: 35 existing explicit-negative TRAIN photos plus 12 previously reviewed whole-photo TRAIN absence overlays; no unknown/ROI queries relabelled absent
capacity_probe.training_negative_queries_per_photo: 32 highest baseline billboard logits plus 32 evenly spaced other query indices
capacity_probe.class_balance: equal positive/negative total mass, equal photo mass within class
metrics: held TRAIN-fold average precision on queries
held absent-photo fraction with any positive query
capacity_probe.choice_policy: No tuning or model promotion from these diagnostics; fixed configuration is exploratory and informed by consumed earlier development history
capacity_probe.scope_limit: Identity disjoint folds do not establish scene-disjoint or independent test accuracy; fixed selected queries condition on geometry coverage

app_backlog_secondary: Measured package/runtime bloat audit before deletions
Small searchable guide and navigation utility only if useful; no feature work in this pass
